integrity: The proof uses the hyperelliptic even-subset model and two independent combinatorial enumerations; finite field tests are reproducibility checks and are not proofs for all fields.
scientific_limitations: Counts are for literal ordered smooth coefficient pairs and Frobenius-stable maximal Weil-isotropic subgroup schemes of Jacobian two-torsion; no distinct targets, moduli-isomorphism counts, or independent validation claimed. An unindexed equivalent historical computation remains possible.
title: Rational \((2,2,2)\)-isogeny kernels in a genus-three Klein-four pencil
